view_a: The first numeric API comparison used the current query clock while the dashboard selected the earlier experiment end. Browser inspection found No data for later-published batch gauges. Original A receipts and PC browser evidence are retained; A is not accepted as visual completion.

frequency: Exact ledger count divided by measured elapsed time is separate from the original observer one-minute extrapolated Prometheus rate. This selected synthetic cohort is not a production-prevalence estimate.
omissions: No real prompt corpus, runtime Secret objects, private credential files, model weights, bulk data or cloud bootstrap metadata.
